description: MOSAIC provides a multi-domain and multi-scale co-simulation framework for traffic, communications and automated mobility. The provider is Eclipse MOSAIC project. Geographical and temporal coverage: Eclipse MOSAIC connects models through standard interfaces and distributes example scenarios. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is Eclipse Public License 2.0. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
